title: CBP guidance on Executive Order 14324 suspending duty-free de minimis treatment
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. The CBP knowledge article states that, under Executive Order 14324 of July 30, 2025, duty-free de minimis treatment is no longer available from August 29, 2025 for shipments not covered by 50 U.S.C. 1702(b), including international mail, and that goods from all countries valued at or below $800 are subject to all applicable duties. It does not give a duty amount for any particular bicycle or frame.
